text:
maya: Quick UX/AX review for Compliance > Data settings before tomorrow's release. Three small but blocking nits: encryption badge copy & affordance, retention unit wording, and region selector tab flow.

sam: drop the copy and i'll patch.

maya: current badge: 'Encrypted (KMS)'. tooltip: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). Learn more about key rotation and access controls in the docs.' wraps badly on mobile.

rija: SR note: parentheses and acronyms read awkwardly. Prefer 'Encryption: customer-managed key' for the short label. Keep 'KMS' in docs only.

ada: Contrast check: our green (~#008a56) is ~2.9:1. Fails AA. Suggest #006644 or light bg + dark text with 1px border.

alyssa: also it's a <span> now so not keyboard-focusable. Make it a <button> with aria-describedby -> tooltip id. Use aria-label like 'Encryption: customer-managed key. Press enter for details'.

maya: proposed short badge: 'Encrypted — customer key' and tooltip short: 'Encrypted with your customer-managed key. Only users with key access can decrypt. See docs.' Keep it concise for mobile/bottom-sheet.

sam: fine. I'll implement button pattern and bottom-sheet on mobile. Tooltip id kms-tooltip-190111 so we can reference.

maya: second nit: visual order is Region -> Retention, but DOM is reversed. Keyboard audit shows tab lands on retention first.

alyssa: repro: staging -> Settings -> tab through form -> hits retention value input (shows '90' only) -> then region. Confusing.

ada: audit log wording shows 'Retention set to 90' which confused reviewers. Change logs to 'Retention set to 90 days' and include optional 'reason' when admins update retention.

rija: UI should show units inline (e.g., '90 days') and keep hidden machine value as number for telemetry. Also ensure ARIA for the combined control.

sam: action items: 1) change badge to <button> with aria-describedby, new copy, darker green #006644; 2) reorder DOM to match visual layout; 3) make retention input display unit suffix 'days' and update audit log message template; 4) mobile: tooltip -> bottom sheet behavior.

alyssa: i'll add e2e checks: keyboard tab order, SR announcement for badge, contrast check, and audit log message test. Will add a test to verify 'reason' field shows in audit export when provided.

maya: timeline: small patch today -> PR -> staging. i'll review keyboard flow post-deploy. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled by @sam at 1901112236 :rocket:

maya: thanks all — small polish but important for compliance and accessibility.
